label: how to {outcome} so fast it feels like cheating
pattern: (?i)\bhow to (?P<outcome>.+?) so fast it feels like cheating\b
psychology: a wanted outcome, faster than plausible; reads as unfair advantage

label: if you don't understand {mechanism}, you don't understand {outcome}
pattern: (?i)\bif you (?:don't|do not|dont|don’t) understand (?P<mechanism>.+?),? you (?:don't|do not|dont|don’t) understand (?P<outcome>.+)
psychology: pattern interrupt + curiosity + loss framing; bridges an unvalued mechanism to a wanted outcome
